book: Theological treatise by Olevianus, De substantia foederis gratuiti inter Deum et electos (Geneva, 1585), with a dedication and an epistle up front, then two parts: Pars prima expounds the covenant of grace through the twelve articles of the Apostles' Creed, with sub-headings by creed phrase, and Pars altera treats the testimonies of the covenant.
